story: At 10:17 on a sunny Sunday morning in Sumter Oaks, Gary is inside his garage mounting light brackets and running the harness along his golf cart while the door stays closed. Donna is carefully hiding extra flamingos behind her hedge so that only three stand in view along Magnolia Loop, and Hal is scanning the street through his binoculars, counting birds and sizing up any cart modifications he can spot. Meanwhile, Rosa is settling in with a cup of coffee, content to wait for Hal to walk up her path while she considers what to say to the neighbors about the Halloween decor deadline.
events: Gary (gary golf cart): Mount the roof brackets and run the tested light harness and speaker leads, keeping the cart inside the garage
Donna (donna flamingo flock): Carry the extra flamingos behind the hedge, leaving exactly three visible from the street
Hal (hal binoculars): Scan Magnolia Loop for the flamingo count and any cart modifications visible from the street
Rosa waited: Pour myself a cup of coffee and settle in, watching for Hal to come up the walk while I think about what to say to the neighbors about the Halloween decor deadline.

gary.thought_process: Bench-tested the harness last tick and it all worked. Now it's time to mount the light strips and speaker on the cart itself. But L-01 says exterior mods visible from the street need Architectural Review approval, and the parade wants it done right. I can do the mounting work in the garage, out of view, and handle the paperwork before the cart goes out on Magnolia Loop. Holiday lighting is legal from Thanksgiving, so I've got time. For now, get the roof frame mounting done while the sun's out and nobody's around to hover over me.

parameters.content: Mount the roof brackets and run the tested light harness and speaker leads, keeping the cart inside the garage

donna.thought_process: I promised Hal I'd thin the flock to three flamingos before the parade, and I've tried this twice already without it seeming to stick. The flamingo flock is right here on Magnolia Loop. Rather than repeat the same vague gesture, I'll physically move the extras behind the hedge so only three show from the street. That keeps me within L-02 and keeps my word to Hal. Then I can go find Gary for more court time.

parameters.content: Carry the extra flamingos behind the hedge, leaving exactly three visible from the street

hal.thought_process: Halloween's over, it's a sunny Sunday morning, and I'm on my porch with no one in sight. My notebook entries on Gary's cart and Donna's flamingos are updated, but I never got a clean count from the street. The binoculars are right here. Better to do my own recon than rely on anyone's promises. Magnolia Loop is where the evidence is, and a man who can't verify a count has no business filing a complaint. If I find the flock still over three, I'll have my case for the review committee. Though I'll admit a soft spot for Donna's coffee-club crowd, rules are rules.

parameters.content: Scan Magnolia Loop for the flamingo count and any cart modifications visible from the street

rosa.thought_process: It's 10:17 AM, Sunday. Coffee is brewed, mugs and pastries are set out for Hal's porch visit, and the dishes from last night are done. My schedule is already checked, so I'm clear. Nobody is in line-of-sight and Hal said tomorrow-ish for coffee, so there's nothing to say yet. Rather than fuss with the kitchen again, I should wait by the porch, relax with a mug, and be ready when he shows up. The Halloween decoration note about November 7 is worth mentioning to the neighbors later.

parameters.content: Pour myself a cup of coffee and settle in, watching for Hal to come up the walk while I think about what to say to the neighbors about the Halloween decor deadline.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
